newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico steelmaker G. Collado completes IPO.
newsitem.headline: Mexico steelmaker G. Collado completes IPO.

text.p: Mexican steelmaker G. Collado has completed an initial public offering of 13.1 million shares with a value of 182.88 million pesos on the Mexican stock exchange, the Bolsa de Valores said on Monday.
The offering represents 31.1 percent of the company's equity. The offer price was established at 13.95 pesos per share, it said in a statement.
"The proceeds from the offering will be used to cancel bank debt that was used to finance a service and distribution center, the purchase of machinery and requirements for working capital," it added.
Monday's offering brings to 12 the number of companies that have made share offerings on the Mexican exchange this year. The offerings total of 2.2 billion pesos.
